name: Social Media Carousel Automation · Baserow setup (run once)

parameters.formTitle: Social Media Carousel Automation · Baserow setup
parameters.formDescription: Creates the "Carousel Automation" database (Content, Slides) in your local Baserow. Your login is only sent to your own Baserow.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ email: $json['Baserow email'], username: $json['Baserow email'], password: $json['Baserow password'] }) }}

parameters.content:
## Run once
Open the form (Execute workflow), enter your Baserow login. Creates the Carousel Automation database with all fields and buttons, then shows the table IDs.
Afterwards you can delete this execution under Executions (it contains your password).
